environment.description: Deployed in an EKS pod with a gVisor (runsc) runtime class. The pod spec includes a securityContext with readOnlyRootFilesystem:true and a custom seccomp profile loaded via the node's /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/git-service.json. The seccomp profile operates in SCMP_ACT_ERRNO mode for the execve family (specifically: __NR_execve returns EPERM when argc > 4 OR when the first argument path does not match the prefix /usr/bin/git). Additionally, the pod runs with a NetworkPolicy that restricts egress to only the kubernetes DNS service (UDP 53) and the internal git-server on port 9418. The service mesh sidecar (Istio with STRICT mTLS) performs L7 request normalization on the ingress path but does NOT inspect POST bodies.

config.seccomp_profile: /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/git-service.json - SCMP_ACT_ERRNO for execve when argv[0] not matching /usr/bin/git prefix, SCMP_ACT_ALLOW for execve with /usr/bin/git prefix and argc<=4
config.network_policy: egress only to kube-dns:53/UDP and git-server.internal:9418/TCP
config.service_mesh: Istio 1.19 STRICT mTLS, L7 normalization on ingress, no POST body inspection
